evals.name: General Purpose Parameter Sweep
evals.description: Tests that the agent correctly classifies a non-DL script as general purpose and generates a proper experiment function
evals.prompt: I have this antenna sweep script at /projects/antenna/scripts/sweepAntennaLength.m. I want to create an experiment that sweeps the antenna length and width values so I can compare bandwidth results across configurations.

assertions.description: Generated function accesses parameters via params struct
Function signature matches general purpose pattern: outputs = func(params)
assertions.expected: Function has signature [out1, ...] = functionName(params) with only params as input

assertions.description: Generated experiment function passes checkcode static analysis

evals.name: Built-in Training with trainnet
evals.description: Tests classification as built-in training and correct Form A signature with trainnet-based code
evals.prompt: I have a CNN training script at /projects/imgclass/trainImageClassifier.m that uses trainnet. I want to experiment with different learning rates and mini-batch sizes. Create an experiment for this.

context.setup: Ensure Deep Learning Toolbox is available

assertions.description: Function signature ends with net, lossFcn, options as the last 3 outputs
assertions.expected: Last three output arguments are net, lossFcn, options in that order

assertions.description: trainingOptions uses Plots none to suppress GUI in experiment trials
Swept parameters accessed through params struct
Generated setup function passes checkcode static analysis

evals.name: Custom Training Loop with Monitor
evals.description: Tests classification as custom training and correct monitor integration pattern
evals.prompt: I have a custom GAN training loop at /projects/gan/customTrainGAN.m using dlnetwork and dlfeval. I want to compare different learning rates. Create an experiment from this.

context.setup: Ensure Deep Learning Toolbox is available

assertions.description: Function signature includes monitor as second input argument
Training loop checks monitor.Stop for early termination
Uses recordMetrics to log training progress to Experiment Manager
Custom training must not use trainingOptions (that is for built-in only)

evals.name: Absolute Path Resolution
evals.description: Tests that relative file paths in user code are resolved to absolute paths using fullfile
evals.prompt: I have a training script at /projects/mywork/trainModelRelativePaths.m that loads data from relative paths. Create an experiment to sweep learning rate and mini-batch size.

context.setup: Ensure Deep Learning Toolbox is available

assertions.description: Uses fullfile() for constructing data file paths
All relative paths in the original script are resolved to absolute paths in the generated function code
assertions.expected: The generated experiment/setup function code uses fullfile() with absolute path components for ALL data file references. No relative paths like '../shared', './data', or 'data/' appear inside the function body. The original script had load('data/train.mat') and load('../shared/validation.mat') — both must be resolved to absolute fullfile() calls in the generated code.

assertions.description: Generated function passes checkcode static analysis

evals.name: Design Confirmation Before Execution
evals.description: Tests that the agent presents the design for review and asks for confirmation before creating files
evals.prompt: I have an optimization script at /projects/optim/optimizeRosenbrock.m. I want to create an experiment to sweep step size and max iterations. Show me the design first before creating anything.

assertions.description: Function code is presented before the summary table, not after
assertions.expected: Generated function code appears before the summary table in the response

assertions.description: Summary table includes experiment type and parameter list
Agent asks for user confirmation before creating project or writing files
assertions.expected: Agent pauses and asks for confirmation or approval before executing MATLAB code to create the experiment

assertions.description: Agent does not call createExperiment or matlab.project.createProject before getting confirmation
